record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings (4): fix-ci-runner-tests invariant-violation judgment (dashboard/app.py guards swallow NoMatches whenever any panel is missing, so a renamed panel id would render blank without an error; NEEDS_PANELS duplicates the ids in compose(); follow() still calls query_one("#needs-error") unguarded); fix-ci-runner-tests missing-test minor (no test pins the guards or shows a missing panel with all selectors present still raises); fix-ci-runner-tests behavior-bug minor (tests/helpers.py wait_workers returns silently after 10 cancelled retries, and tests/test_dashboard_app.py _wait_workers has different semantics); ci-workflow-file invariant-violation judgment (test-tmux adds --reruns 2, so a flake passes on rerun; documented in the README).
integration: six independent jobs; the same four pytest selections in ci.yml, README and the main-branch config command, with the --reruns 2 divergence on tmux only; main's .canon/config.json satisfies R30; no conflicts.
record.subject: ci-workflow-review
